description: This file defines a Perl module 'Git::I18N' that provides an interface to Git's internal gettext localization functions. It includes functions for setting up locale messages and provides fallbacks if 'Locale::Messages' is unavailable.

methods.name: __bootstrap_locale_messages
methods.description: Initializes gettext localization, sets locale, and binds text domains.

methods.name: N__
methods.description: A no-op function that returns its argument, used for extracting translatable strings without translating.
